exclusion_detail: The paper is a bioassay report on compounds 1-20 whose syntheses and characterisation were published earlier (Taha et al. 2015); this paper gives only a three-sentence outline (6-chlorooxindole + 4-formylbenzoic acid, piperidine, then hydrazide formation, then condensation with acetophenones/aldehydes in AcOH) with no procedures, reagents list or the structure of any numbered compound in the text (structures are drawn in figures only).

lead.label: 1 (most potent, IC50 155.22 uM)
lead.why: Abstract lists analogues 1, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 20 as potent, and names no single best; 1 has the lowest IC50 and is shown in Fig. 1, so it is the most defensible reading. Under a strict lead rule this is no_lead_identifiable instead.

notes: Text inconsistency: 'III' is named (E)-4-((5-chloro-2-oxoindolin-3-ylidene)methyl)benzoic acid while the starting material is 6-chlorooxindole and the next compound IV is the 6-chloro hydrazide. 'Prepared by a known methodology (Zhang 2002)' and 'detailed spectroscopic studies reported in our previous study (Taha 2015)'. No SI supplied.
